headline: Front Ledger Shifts Along the Central Line
war_summary: The latest returns show the front still turning chiefly in Nevish Line and Linn Mercy. Nevish Line has quickened from the previous edition, registering 10 base events in two hours and 59 across the day; its ledger remains three Warden, five Colonial, with no neutral positions. Linn Mercy has also intensified, reaching four recent events and 40 in 24 hours, while its present count is 10 Colonial and one neutral base, with no Warden holdings. Callahans Passage recorded two fresh changes and 16 daily, leaving nine Warden bases and one neutral. Weathered Expanse has seen no event in two hours, though nine arrived in six and 43 in the day; seven Warden bases and two neutral remain. Mooring County likewise has no fresh event in the short watch but 16 daily, with 11 Warden and one Colonial holding. Marban Hollow is quiet in the latest two hours after 11 daily changes, and stands divided at four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. Casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating in several live sectors, but the most immediate ownership risk is concentrated in Nevish Line and Linn Mercy.
